annotations.title: Create a landing page from a prompt

description: Generate a responsive single-page landing site (product launch, waitlist, event, portfolio) from a text prompt: one model call plans a multi-section outline (hero, features, social proof, FAQ, closing CTA, footer) and — unless generateImage:false — one hero image, then buildPage composes it as a scrolling section stack in the chosen Style. Returns the new artifact id: read/edit it with read_artifact, redraw its composition with reroll_artifact, download a self-contained static HTML site with export_artifact. Any free-tier degradation (the AI-image budget ran out, so the page kept a text hero) comes back as a warning — never a silent downgrade.

direction.description: Free-form creative direction for the outline

generateImage.description: Generate a hero image (default true). false keeps a text-forward hero.

prompt.description: What the page is for — the product/offer, audience, and key details

seed.description: Reproducible draw; the same seed + Style gives the same page.

styleId.description: A curated Style id from list_styles (e.g. aurora). Default the first curated Style.

name: create_page
title: Create a landing page from a prompt
